name: Barcode Scanner
tagline: A text field with a device barcode/QR scan button — one code, or a run of them.
summary:
A text field with a **Scan** button inside it, drawn like the form's own fields. The button opens the device's native barcode and QR scanner and writes the decoded value into the column; typing the code by hand always works too.

Set **Scan mode** to many codes and the scanner comes back after each code until it is closed: each new code goes on its own line, listed under the field with a count, repeats skipped. Scanning needs a device with a camera or scanner hardware. It works on model-driven forms and in canvas apps.

limitations: The scan is simulated. On the Power Apps mobile app, Scan opens the device's own scanner; the demo has no camera to reach, so the On the mobile app and Scan many presets answer context.device.getBarcodeValue() with a fixed code, 9780201633610, and the event log under the demo says the answer was simulated. What the control does with it is real: the code lands in the field and in the value output a form would save.

The demo answers every call with the same code, so the Scan many preset adds it once and then ends the run on two repeats, saying so — the guard that keeps a host answering by itself from looping. On a phone a run goes on until the scanner is closed; that loop has not been measured on a device yet (see SPEC.md).

The In a desktop browser preset declares no scanner, so getBarcodeValue() is refused and Scan shows the control's own "Scanning isn't available here" state; typing the code in still fills the field, since that path never touches context.device.

presets.name: On the mobile app
presets.description: An empty field on the Power Apps mobile app. Press Scan: the demo answers as the device's scanner would, with a simulated EAN-13, and the code lands in the field.

presets.name: In a desktop browser
presets.description: The same empty field where there is no scanner to call. Scan shows the control's no-scanner state, and typing the code in still works.

presets.name: Scan many
presets.description: Many codes mode with two codes already in the column. Press Scan: the simulated code is added on its own line, then the run ends on the demo's repeated answer. Type a code into the box and press Enter to add it; the button on a row removes it.

presets.name: Already scanned
presets.description: Shows the field's post-scan state without needing a working scanner.
